clue.text: Middle of wheel requiring jack, by the sound of it

indicators.note: this phrase says the word for jack is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: the jack in a pack of cards is also called the knave

explanation.surface: A mechanic's note that a wheel's centre needs a jack, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jack' looks like a car tool, but it is the playing card. The K of the card's other name is silent, so it is said like the hub of a wheel.
explanation.definitionFit: The hub at the centre of a wheel, through which the axle passes, is its nave.

clue.text: Start up with a jerk favouring one's own

indicators.note: in a down clue, up says the word for start is read from the bottom, i.e. backwards

parts.note: to open something is to start it
a tic is an involuntary jerk or twitch

explanation.surface: Someone starts up from sleep with a twitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Start up' reads as a jolt awake, but 'up' is the reversal signal for the down clue, applied to the word for start.
explanation.definitionFit: Nepotism is favouritism shown to one's relatives, so the adjective describes favouring family.

clue.text: Adaptable sort of relatives

indicators.note: to sort something is to rearrange it, so the following word's letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Family members described as flexible types.
explanation.definitionFit: Something versatile can be adapted to many uses or situations: a synonym.

clue.text: In seclusion I've to worry dreadfully

indicators.note: dreadfully suggests things done badly, so the letters of the preceding words are jumbled

explanation.surface: A recluse admits to worrying terribly while shut away.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in an ivory tower is an idiom for living withdrawn from the practical world, secluded from reality.

clue.text: Travel by water, not straight up the creek outside

indicators.note: outside says the word for creek wraps around the other piece

parts.note: a voe is a small bay or creek in Orkney and Shetland

indicators.note: in a down clue, up says the word is read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: gay is slang for not straight, i.e. not heterosexual

explanation.surface: A sea journey that wanders crookedly up a creek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns the word for not straight in this down clue; 'outside' puts the creek around it. A voe is an inlet in Orkney and Shetland dialect.
explanation.definitionFit: A voyage is a long journey, especially one made by sea: a journey over water.

clue.text: Instrument found on the bench

definitions.meaning: a woodwind instrument, the simple fipple flute played in schools
a part-time judge in English courts, who sits on the bench

explanation.surface: A musical instrument left lying on a bench.
explanation.walkthrough: In England and Wales a recorder is a barrister or solicitor sitting as a part-time judge; 'the bench' is the judges collectively.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a woodwind instrument and a kind of part-time judge, giving two separate senses.

clue.text: Stall inquirers shifting drugs

indicators.note: shifting signals the letters of the preceding words move into a new order

explanation.surface: A dealer stalls nosy questioners while moving narcotics.
explanation.definitionFit: Tranquillisers are sedative drugs that calm anxiety, so they are examples of drugs.

clue.text: Group of women — 200 — joining a cult

parts.note: the WI is the Women's Institute, a British organisation for women
CC is 200 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Two hundred women from a club join a cult together.
explanation.walkthrough: The Women's Institute (WI) is a well-known British women's organisation; 'joining' just links the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Wicca is a modern pagan witchcraft religion, which can be described as a cult.

clue.text: Set free, again experience ecstasy being embraced

indicators.note: being embraced says the letter for ecstasy is held inside the other piece

parts.note: to relive something is to experience it again
E is the common abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A freed person reliving the bliss of being hugged.
explanation.definitionFit: To relieve someone of a burden or duty is to set them free from it.

clue.text: Hippy, American woman caught by headlights

parts.note: broad is American slang for a woman
something caught by headlights is in their beam

explanation.surface: A hippy American woman frozen in a car's headlights.
explanation.definitionFit: Broad in the beam is an idiom for having wide hips, a nautical image of a wide ship.

clue.text: Picture with light on the left

indicators.note: on here places the word for left before the word for light

parts.note: port is the left-hand side of a ship
a ray is a beam of light

explanation.surface: A painting lit from the left-hand side.
explanation.definitionFit: To portray someone is to depict them, as in a picture or description.

clue.text: Husband brought in to scrub what's behind the screen

indicators.note: brought in says the letter for husband is put inside the word for scrub

parts.note: to scrub a plan is to cancel it

explanation.surface: A husband is called in to clean up behind a screen.
explanation.walkthrough: In a church the chancel lies beyond the rood screen that divides it from the nave, so the definition is a fair description.
explanation.definitionFit: A chancel is the part of a church near the altar, traditionally set behind a rood screen.

clue.text: Battle on the level ground near Charing Cross

parts.note: Trafalgar was Nelson's famous naval battle of 1805
on the level means honest, as does square

explanation.surface: A battle fought on flat ground close to a London station.
explanation.walkthrough: Charing Cross is a central London station and junction; the famous square is right beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Trafalgar Square is a public open space in London close to Charing Cross: a piece of ground there.

clue.text: Make a contribution, putting your number on the letter

indicators.note: on here places the number after the letter in the across answer

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
a PIN is a personal identification number

explanation.surface: Writing your PIN on a letter as your part in something.
explanation.definitionFit: To chip in is an idiom for contributing money or a remark to a shared effort.

clue.text: Inferior doctor carries round note

indicators.note: carries says the doctor holds the round letter inside

parts.note: a medic is a doctor
O is round in shape
re is the second note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A second-rate doctor carries a round note.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mediocre is of only moderate or poor quality, hence inferior.

clue.text: Where to find a lot of soldiers working at cricket

definitions.text: Where to find a lot of soldiers

indicators.note: working suggests the letters are worked over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Lots of soldiers busy playing cricket.
explanation.walkthrough: Catterick, in North Yorkshire, is home to the British Army's largest garrison.
explanation.definitionFit: Catterick Garrison is a large British Army base, so many soldiers are stationed there.

clue.text: Easterner, old one, accommodated in house to let in New York

indicators.note: accommodated in says the letter for one is housed inside the other piece

parts.words: house to let in New York
parts.note: a rental is the American term for a property to let
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An elderly Easterner lodged in a rented New York home.
explanation.definitionFit: An Oriental is a dated term for a person from East Asia, an Easterner.

clue.text: Eye a lively river

parts.note: pert means lively or saucy
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Spotting a sparkling river.
explanation.definitionFit: An eye is a small hole or opening, as in the eye of a needle, which is an aperture.

clue.text: Records a Catholic has to put in store

parts.note: RC stands for Roman Catholic
to hive something away is to store it

explanation.surface: A Catholic's papers must be kept in storage.
explanation.definitionFit: An archive is a collection of historical records or documents.

clue.text: A heavy coat, in Paul's terminology

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the following words

explanation.surface: A heavy coat described in St Paul's language.
explanation.definitionFit: An ulster is a long, loose, heavy overcoat, originally made in Northern Ireland.

clue.text: Fruit got up with it

parts.note: rose is the past tense of rise, to get up
hip means fashionable, with it

explanation.surface: Getting up with a piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosehip is the red fruit of the rose plant.

clue.text: Pack in very skimpy garment -—- the last bit of beachwear

indicators.note: in places the last letter of beachwear inside the garment

parts.note: a thong is a very skimpy piece of underwear or swimwear

indicators.note: this phrase takes the final letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Packing a tiny thong as the final beachwear item.
explanation.definitionFit: A throng is a crowd, as is a pack of people.

clue.text: Game giving rise to rumours in Beijing

definitions.text: Game giving rise to rumours in Beijing

parts.words: Game giving rise to rumours in Beijing
parts.note: a party game where a message passed in murmurs gets garbled, read here as gossip spreading in the Chinese capital

explanation.surface: A game that starts rumours in Beijing.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a party game in which a message passed along a line becomes distorted, much like rumour.

clue.text: Gore coagulated after batting

indicators.note: after puts the word for coagulated following the word for batting

parts.note: in cricket the side batting is in
something that has set has thickened or coagulated

explanation.surface: Blood clotted after an innings at the crease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gore' looks like blood, but it is a triangular piece of cloth set into a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A gore is a tapered panel of fabric let into a garment, which is a kind of inset.

clue.text: Vet injects small creature with painkiller initially

indicators.note: injects says the first letter of painkiller goes inside the creature

parts.note: an insect is a small creature

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the word painkiller

explanation.surface: A vet gives a small animal a painkilling injection.
explanation.definitionFit: To vet something is to examine it carefully, to inspect it.

clue.text: This is monstrous — therefore reversing is hard

indicators.note: reversing says the word for therefore is read backwards

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A complaint that reversing a car is monstrously difficult.
explanation.definitionFit: Ogreish means like an ogre, a monster, hence monstrous.

clue.text: Science striking gloomy note

indicators.note: striking suggests the letters are knocked about into a new order

explanation.surface: A scientist strikes a gloomy tone.
explanation.definitionFit: Entomology is the scientific study of insects, a branch of science.

clue.text: Bob, a leading curler

definitions.meaning: to bob along lightly is to hop or ...
the captain of a curling team is called the ...

explanation.surface: Bob is the top curler on the team.
explanation.definitionFit: Skip means to bob or hop lightly, and is also the term for the captain of a curling rink.
